paper: Pailitao-VL: Unified Embedding and Reranker for Real-Time Multi-Modal Industrial Search
task: Pailitao 图搜 embedding 和 rerank
core_method: MLLM2Vec 加超大规模 ID classification；additive angular margin；compare-and-calibrate listwise reranker
reported_gain: Embedding 平均 73.73 vs TBStars 69.55；线上 GMV +2%/+6%/+20%；67ms embedding 和 76ms reranker
evidence_level: 作者论文和线上 A/B 报告
workability: 强，适合有商品 ID 簇、图搜 GMV 闭环和高质量治理能力的平台
risk: 原型簇污染会固化噪声；线上分桶和长期影响未公开

paper: TIGER-FG: Text-Guided Implicit Fine-Grained Grounding for E-commerce Retrieval
core_method: 文本引导 item 表征；region-text 对齐；target-anchor；SDD/SRD 蒸馏；Mosaic clutter 训练
reported_gain: Recall@1 对最强基线 +6.1pp normal 和 +34.4pp mosaic；85.7M query 参数
workability: 强，适合截图裁剪图搜、商详图含背景和多主体干扰的召回通道
risk: 需要区域框或高质量目标区域训练信号；线上 A/B 未公开

paper: Text-Guided Visual Representation Learning for Robust Multimodal E-Commerce Recommendation
core_method: TGQ-Former：metadata-anchored queries + exploratory queries + 双门控 + redundancy reduction
workability: 强，适合商品相似、看了又看、召回预计算 item embedding
risk: 主要是 I2I 而非 query image to item；线上效果未公开

paper: UniECS: Towards Unified Multimodal E-Commerce Search
task: 文本、图像、图文组合统一检索
core_method: Gated fusion；cross-modal / cross-level / intra-modal contrastive losses；M-BEER benchmark
reported_gain: M-BEER text-to-image R@10 0.85 vs GME 0.57；线上 SCR +27.31%、CTR +2.74%、CVR +4.67%、order +6.12%、revenue +8.33%
evidence_level: 作者论文和线上 A/B 报告
workability: 强，适合希望统一多入口搜索和同款相似召回的平台
risk: 统一模型要防止某一入口牺牲；需做分入口和分品类 guardrail

paper: Beyond Text: Text-Image Fusion for Scalable Two-Tower Retrieval
task: 文本 query 到图文商品双塔召回
core_method: Item-tower 图文 MoE+Bilinear 融合；domain FT；query-to-text/image alignment；CPU ANN
reported_gain: nDCG@1 desirability +4.86%；relevance +2.36%；约 2000 QPS CPU serving
evidence_level: 作者论文，离线和部署描述
workability: 强，适合现有 text-only ANN 想低风险加视觉信号
risk: 当前是文本 query 为主；在线业务指标未公开

paper: OneRetrieval: Unifying Multi-Branch E-commerce Retrieval with an Editable Generative Model
task: 多路召回统一和可编辑生成式召回
core_method: KAE attribute-word identifiers；reserved slots；four-stage fine-tuning
reported_gain: 替换倒排 order +0.710%；近全替换 CTR +0.821%；服务数亿 PV/day
evidence_level: 作者论文和线上 A/B 报告
workability: 中强，适合多路召回治理和运营强干预系统
risk: 不是纯图搜；生成式召回覆盖、热品偏置和人工编辑一致性需长期验证

paper: Efficient Generative Retrieval for E-commerce Search with Semantic Cluster IDs and Expert-Guided RL
core_method: CQ-SID；category-aware RQ-VAE；query-item contrastive；EG-GRPO
reported_gain: GMV +1.15%；UCTCVR +0.40%；8 GPUs 约 200 QPS；平均 40ms
evidence_level: 作者论文和线上 A/B 报告
workability: 中强，适合作为召回补充而非一步替换全量 ANN
risk: 多目标 reward 稳定性、beam size、GPU 成本需要线上控制

paper: Unified Learning-to-Rank for Multi-Channel Retrieval in Large-Scale E-Commerce Search
core_method: 把 channel merge 改成 query-dependent LTR；engagement features；conversion-weighted label
reported_gain: Conversion +2.85%；p95 latency 低于 50ms；Target.com 部署
evidence_level: 作者论文和线上 A/B 报告
workability: 强，适合电商召回阶段的候选融合层
risk: 不是视觉模型；依赖稳定的 channel features 和周级 query-item 统计

paper: AFMRL: Attribute-Enhanced Fine-Grained Multi-Modal Representation Learning in E-commerce
task: 细粒度同款和跨模态检索
core_method: MLLM attribute generation；AGCL hard-negative filtering；RAR with Recall@k reward；GRPO
reported_gain: Recall@1 48.05 到 54.28；SFT+RL+CIT accuracy 89.13
evidence_level: 正式会议论文，离线实验
workability: 中强，适合已有属性体系且要提升细粒度可解释性的场景
risk: 属性生成质量和 RL reward 会影响稳定性；线上信号未公开

paper: MOON Embedding: Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Search Advertising
task: 搜索广告多模态表征和召回中间指标
core_method: Pretraining, post-training, application 三阶段；exchange rate 选择 image-based search recall
reported_gain: 全链路部署；线上 CTR +20.00%；image search Recall@1 95.1%
evidence_level: 作者技术报告和线上 A/B 报告
workability: 强，适合广告/推荐链路把图搜召回作为中间指标
risk: 指标定义和广告链路偏向会影响迁移到自然图搜

paper: Qwen3-VL-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Reranker
task: 通用多模态 embedding 和 reranker
core_method: 大规模对比预训练；reranker distillation；Matryoshka；cross-encoder rerank
reported_gain: MMEB-V2 77.8，较上一开源最佳 +6.7%
workability: 强，适合作为强 baseline、teacher 和离线 reranker
risk: 非电商专用，实例级同款需要领域后训练

paper: Bringing Multimodality to Amazon Visual Search System
task: 视觉搜索和图文组合查询
core_method: 3-tower image-text alignment；4-tower 加 reformulation text；embedding arithmetic
reported_gain: 3-tower image matching CTR +4.95%；4-tower 进一步 +1.13%
workability: 强，适合图搜系统从纯视觉升级为图文约束
risk: 论文较早，未覆盖 MLLM/细粒度生成式新范式

paper: MIEM: Transformer-empowered Multi-modal Item Embedding for Enhanced E-commerce Image Search
core_method: Transformer 融合多模态商品语义补充图搜
reported_gain: 部署后 clicks/user +9.90%；orders/user +4.23%
workability: 强，适合验证“图像检索需要商品语义补充”的产业基线
risk: 架构相对 2026 新模型不够前沿

paper: MAKE: Vision-Language Pre-training based Product Retrieval in Taobao Search
task: 文本 query 到图文商品召回
core_method: Modal adaptation；query-title-image V+L pretraining；大规模负采样
reported_gain: 部署到 Taobao Search，服务数亿用户；论文报告主要线上改善
workability: 强，适合作为早期工业 V+L 召回范式
risk: 旧方法，需升级到更强视觉编码器和后训练策略

paper: Delving into E-Commerce Product Retrieval with Vision-Language Pre-training
core_method: 视觉预训练任务；tailored negative sampling；线上召回通道
reported_gain: 作为 Taobao Search 一路召回服务数亿用户
workability: 强，适合作为工业负采样和上线链路参考
risk: 公式和模型能力已被 2025/2026 MLLM embedding 超越

paper: Multimodal Semantic Retrieval for Product Search
core_method: BiBERT text-only + CLIP 3-tower/4-tower item representations
reported_gain: 论文显示 purchase recall 或 relevance accuracy 提升，4-tower 有 40 到 50 bps recall 改善
workability: 中，适合 text-only semantic retrieval 增量改造
risk: 线上业务收益未公开

paper: Unsupervised Multi-Modal Representation Learning for High Quality Retrieval of Similar Products at E-commerce Scale
core_method: Contrastive learning + ANNS Pareto frontier
reported_gain: 部分品类 retrieval@1 翻倍；6.8x speedup with about 2% accuracy drop
workability: 中强，适合大规模相似召回和 ANN 选型
risk: 偏同款/相似召回，非开放图文 query

paper: De-noised Vision-Language Fusion Guided by Visual Cues for E-commerce Product Search
task: 商品搜索 V+L 融合
core_method: 视觉线索引导文本去噪和融合
reported_gain: 论文报告商品搜索相关提升
workability: 中，适合标题噪声强的商品库
risk: 需要细读任务口径；不是纯召回系统论文

paper: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding
core_method: CoT/attribute deconstruction；multi-head fusion；contrastive + RL；residual detail enhancement
reported_gain: MBE3.0 和 public datasets zero-shot SOTA
workability: 中，适合前沿观察和属性推理增强
risk: 训练复杂，线上召回稳定性待公开

paper: FashionMV: Product-Level Composed Image Retrieval with Multi-View Fashion Data
task: 多视角商品级 composed image retrieval
core_method: ProCIR；two-stage dialogue；caption alignment；CoT；optional SFT
reported_gain: 0.8B 模型优于 10x size 通用 embedding；127K products 和 220K triplets
evidence_level: 作者论文，公开数据/代码
workability: 中，适合服饰多视角和“找同款但改颜色/款式”
risk: 垂直服饰，数据自动生成，需要人工质检

paper: RMIR: A Benchmark Dataset for Reasoning-Intensive Multimodal Image Retrieval
task: 复杂推理式图像检索 benchmark
core_method: 功能、时间、因果三类 reasoning query；生成式 embedding 对比
reported_gain: 最佳模型 Recall@20 46.53%，显著暴露能力缺口
workability: 中，适合构造下一代图搜评测集
risk: 不是电商商品库，不能直接代表线上 GMV

paper: MagicLens: Self-Supervised Image Retrieval with Open-Ended Instructions
core_method: Self-supervised instruction-conditioned retrieval
reported_gain: 开放式图像检索强 baseline
workability: 中，适合 composed/query-conditioned 图搜研究
risk: 非电商场景，线上召回落地需重训

paper: Graph-based Multilingual Product Retrieval in E-commerce Search
core_method: Multilingual transformer + graph attention over query-item-product relations
reported_gain: 五国离线 recall +35%、mAP +25%；线上 conversion/revenue 显著提升
workability: 强，适合跨境电商召回非视觉部分
risk: 不是图搜模型，但对国际化召回很有工程价值

paper: Scaling Cross-Domain Content-Based Image Retrieval for E-commerce Snap and Search Application
task: 跨域用户图到商品图 CBIR
core_method: Cascade method；视觉搜索和分类结合；cross-domain gallery/query
reported_gain: 报告真实电商 snap and search 的 ranking 和 latency impact
workability: 中，适合图搜系统工程基线
risk: 论文较短，指标细节有限

paper: Large-Scale Product Retrieval with Weakly Supervised Representation Learning
core_method: 伪属性挖掘；multi-label classification；whitening；rerank；ensemble
reported_gain: 71.53% MAR，eProduct leaderboard 第二
workability: 中，适合低标注商品库冷启动
risk: 竞赛集和线上系统差距较大

paper: VLM2Vec / VLM2Vec-V2
core_method: VLM contrastive adaptation；instruction-aware multimodal vector
reported_gain: MMEB 相对既有模型平均 +10% 到 +20%
workability: 中，适合做通用 teacher/baseline
risk: 电商实例级属性和同款需要领域数据

paper: CLIP / SigLIP
core_method: InfoNCE 或 pairwise sigmoid 图文对齐
reported_gain: 通用基础模型贡献，不是电商线上指标
workability: 强，作为初始化和 teacher
risk: 直接零样本用于电商同款通常不稳定

paper: ColPali and Late Interaction Retrieval
core_method: MaxSim token-level late interaction
reported_gain: 视觉文档检索强，但与商品召回任务不同
workability: 中，适合 rerank 和高精场景启发
risk: 多向量索引成本高，第一阶段召回要谨慎
